verdict.rationale: Loops documents transactional email as a distinct feature (loops-docs-22, loops-docs-13) but repeatedly emphasizes a single unified contact model and API for both transactional and marketing sends (loops-docs-21, loops-docs-32), with no documentation of separate suppression lists, dedicated sending reputation, or explicit confirmation that a receipt still delivers to an unsubscribed contact. Missing for 10: explicit suppression-rule separation, evidence transactional bypasses marketing opt-outs, and any reputation/IP isolation documentation.
